stories.bedtime: Once upon a time, in a small forest, there was a brave little bunny who loved making new friends. One day the bunny met a tiny butterfly and together they had an adventure discovering colorful flowers.

abc.alphabet_rhyme: A is for apple, red and sweet. B is for ball, bouncing by your feet. C is for cat, cuddly and soft. D is for duck, swimming in the trough.

colors.red: Red is the color of strawberries and fire trucks!
colors.blue: Blue is the color of the sky and the sea.
colors.yellow: Yellow is the color of bananas and sunshine!
